bio: I am an Associate Researcher at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC). I received my Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering (Robotics) from UESTC under the supervision of Prof. Bei Peng. From 2024 to 2025, I was a CSC-sponsored visiting Ph.D. researcher at Nanyang Technological University, working with Prof. Tee Hiang Cheng.

My research interests include embodied intelligence, reinforcement learning, generative models, and signal processing. My current work focuses on diffusion- and flow-based reinforcement learning, multimodal policy and value representations, entropy estimation for exploration, and robust estimation under non-Gaussian noise.
